plan_prompt:
## Settled design (the planner grounds it; nobody re-derives it)

1. DESIGN-EXTENSIONS.md: a component declaration carries shape + view +
   ACTIONS + schedule. K6 (declared faces, landed manifold e58973d) built the
   view half; this leg builds the actions half the SAME way.
2. K6 precedent, ruled at ROUND-20260813-VIEW-EYES-WORKFLOWS.md r1.2 and now
   proven in the tree: capability declarations travel as RECORD ENTRIES on
   the registry feed, never code; a closed v1 vocabulary grows only by core
   release; carried implementations win over declared ones for their tokens.
3. K8 DELIVERY MODEL — ruled here (Waffles, 2026-08-14, extending the K6
   precedent under Tom's 2026-08-12 technical delegation):
   - Actions travel as a new facet `manifold.facet.actions@v1` on the
     component declaration. Body: `{ "actions": { "<kind-token>":
     [ <action>... ] } }`. Unknown facets already travel verbatim — the core
     needs NO change (⛔ STOP-REPORT if any crates/ change seems required).
   - An action is one of exactly TWO closed v1 primitives:
     * `{ "primitive": "respond", "label": "<literal>",
        "kind": "<record-kind-token>", "body": { ...literal template... } }`
       — ONE control; pressing it IS the act (Tom's click-is-the-act ruling):
       it sends a signed record entry of the declared kind through the
       page's EXISTING write door, body = the declared literal template plus
       a reference to the acted-on entry. No composer detour.
     * `{ "primitive": "choose", "from": "<list-field>",
        "kind": "<record-kind-token>" }` — one control PER ITEM of the
       acted-on record's list field; pressing an item sends a signed entry
       of the declared kind carrying that item plus the reference. This is
       the vote shape, generalized.
   - deny-unknown-fields at every level; unknown primitive names or missing
     members are MALFORMED and refuse BY NAME (the declared-face refusal
     register). A `choose` over a non-list value refuses that action,
     renders the rest.
   - The act routes through the page's existing write path ONLY. No write
     path for the room ⇒ the control renders disabled with the refusal in
     words (the exact precedent of the poll vote refusal in mount.ts). The
     ownership of signing, sequencing, and delivery stays with the existing
     door — this leg adds ZERO new wire surface.
   - CARRIED-WINS: poll's hand-wired vote path is the carried specimen and
     is NOT rewired. ⛔ poll-face.ts and poll.ts untouched. Unifying poll
     onto the general path is a later leg, exactly as poll's face stayed
     hand-wired in K6 leg 1.
   - The K7/K8 fork (per-message action vs whole-room palette verb) is
     TOM'S question and stays OPEN — this leg builds only the per-message
     arm he already asked for. Nothing here forecloses K7.

## Leg topology (sequence, one shared tree — the `legs` input)

- **L1 `schema-red`** — the actions facet reader schema
  (declared-actions vocabulary, respond + choose, deny-unknown), the
  fixture kind `ablative.message.rsvp@v1` (fields: `prompt` text,
  `options` text-list) declared with renders + accepts + face + ACTIONS
  facets beside the existing fixtures, and the RED: a new composition cases
  file asserting derivation, control shape, refusal-by-name, and the
  choose-over-non-list refusal — committed FAILING with the red run's
  output as evidence (gate-logs/declared-actions/red.log in the leg's own
  commit). Report to .fleet/reports/L1.md.
- **L2 `derive-green`** — the derivation module (new file under
  surface/page/src, ≤500 LOC, house style of declared-face.ts) yielding
  per-kind action rosters from mounted declarations, composed
  carried-first at the mount seam; L1's red cases turn green; live
  re-declaration changes the roster with dist/ bytes untouched. Report to
  .fleet/reports/L2.md.
- **L3 `act-walk`** — the controls render on the rendered kind and the
  press SENDS: dev-estate browser walk (never the live estate) — declared
  rsvp kind renders its choose controls, a press produces a signed record
  entry that arrives on the feed, the no-write-path room shows the
  disabled-with-words refusal; walk evidence + dist-bytes-unchanged
  assertion logged (gate-logs/declared-actions/walk.log). Report to
  .fleet/reports/L3.md.

## Hard walls (restated in every leg brief by the planner)

⛔ Live estate untouchable: ports 4176/41100/41101/41102/9490s, every
.manifold* path — dev estates only. ⛔ No crates/ changes (STOP-REPORT).
⛔ No vendor/ edits, no import-map changes, no new served files, no dynamic
import() — code delivery is refused by settled design. ⛔ poll-face.ts +
poll.ts untouched. ⛔ No lint bypasses, no test skips. ⛔ Existing pinned
cases byte-untouched — a pin conflict is a STOP-REPORT, never a rewrite.
Worktree only; never land, merge, push, or deploy — Waffles re-gates the
final tree and lands.

You are the PLANNER of a fleet run. Your working directory is the target repository worktree. Write .fleet/plan.md (the whole plan, every requirement anchored file:line into THIS tree) and one complete builder brief per leg at .fleet/legs/L1.md, .fleet/legs/L2.md, .fleet/legs/L3.md. Each brief is floors-not-ceilings, self-contained, anchored, restates the hard walls above, and names the report file the builder must write (.fleet/reports/<id>.md). You are planning CONTENT for this fixed topology, not changing it. Commit nothing; the .fleet/ files are your only writes. When done, reply with a short summary of the plan you wrote.
